newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower, spreads dominate.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower, spreads dominate.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended lower on Wednesday after the Dow's steep 80-point drop overnight, but dealers said trade was low and dominated by spread activity.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished 85 points lower at 20,625 on volume of 14,000 lots. March was at 20,670 on 6,454 lots.

"If the support of 20,410 is broken, the whole scene looks very bearish," said a chartist with a local institution. He said this could open the way for a drop to 19,960 with intermediate support seen at 20,325.
If the December Nikkei holds above 20,410, it could head higher to test resistance at 20,720-20,770 initially.
"If 20,410 holds well, we'll probably see it reaching 21,500 in the next one or two weeks," he added.
A trader with a Japanese futures house said the December Nikkei looked technically oversold and was likely to be supported by bargain-hunting interest below 20,500.
But he said sentiment for the Nikkei was quite poor with a large number of shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange posting new year lows on Tuesday.
